title: Hujan Turun — Lagu Anak (Kodok dan Payung)
topic: Original Indonesian kids' sing-along about a little frog with an umbrella in the rain (original lyrics and melody)
style: Soft clay-toy 3D: a procedural frog with a yellow umbrella, light-blue rainy sky, rounded hills, puddle ripples. Chunky outlined title type (yellow and white with a thick dark outline). Sing-along lyrics with a bouncing ball. 100 BPM, C major, ukulele, glockenspiel, claps, rain.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: HUJAN TURUN title letters bounce in; the frog pops up under its umbrella; rain starts.

scenes.title: Sing-along
scenes.description: Four lines, one bar each, with syllable highlight and a bouncing ball; the frog bounces on the beat and hops on line three.

scenes.title: Splash
scenes.description: The frog jumps into the puddle, splash rings, MARI BERNYANYI! end card.

narration.text: Plik plok plik plok, hujan turun
